lines.description: Language selection: each card plays its own language.

zu.text: Sawubona! Uma ufuna ukufunda isiNgisi ngesiZulu, thinta lapha.
zu.label: isiZulu

st.text: Dumela! Haeba o batla ho ithuta Senyesemane ka Sesotho, tobetsa mona.
st.label: Sesotho

lines.description: Welcome after choosing a language. Never names the app (the name is configurable).

zu.text: Siyakwamukela! Lapha ufunda ukufunda nokubhala isiNgisi, kancane kancane, ngolimi lwakho. Awudingi ukwazi ukufunda ukuze uqale: lalela, bese uthinta izithombe.

st.text: Rea o amohela! Mona o ithuta ho bala le ho ngola Senyesemane, butle-butle, ka puo ya hao. Ha o hloke ho tseba ho bala ho qala: mamela, ebe o tobetsa ditshwantsho.

zu.text: Lena yinkinobho yokulalela. Iphinda amagama. Yithinte manje.

st.text: Ena ke konopo ya ho mamela. E pheta mantswe. E tobetse jwale.

zu.text: Kuhle! Uma ungezwanga kahle, ungayithinta futhi noma nini.

st.text: Ho hotle! Ha o sa utlwa hantle, o ka e tobetsa hape neng kapa neng.

lines.description: Demo: answering by tapping a picture.

zu.text: Ukuze uphendule, uthinta isithombe. Zama: thinta isithombe esikhulu.

st.text: Ho araba, o tobetsa setshwantsho. Leka: tobetsa setshwantsho se seholo.
Motsu o motala o o isa pele. O tobetse.

lines.description: Demo: help and press-and-hold to hear a button.

zu.text: Uphawu lombuzo wusizo. Futhi uma ucindezela ubambe noma iyiphi inkinobho, uzozwa ukuthi yenzani.

st.text: Letshwao la potso ke thuso. Mme ha o tobetsa o tshware konopo efe kapa efe, o tla utlwa hore e etsang.
O se o loketse!

lines.description: Offer to save progress online (registration) or keep it on the phone (guest).
lines.source: You can keep your learning on this phone only, or keep it safely on the internet so that it is not lost. Keeping it on the internet uses a little data.

zu.text: Ungagcina ukufunda kwakho kule foni kuphela, noma usigcine ku-inthanethi ngokuphepha ukuze singalahleki. Ukugcina ku-inthanethi kusebenzisa idatha encane.

st.text: O ka boloka thuto ya hao founung ena feela, kapa o e boloke inthaneteng ka polokeho hore e se ke ya lahleha. Ho boloka inthaneteng ho sebedisa data e nyane.

lines.description: Button: save online (leads to spoken consent).
lines.source: I want to keep it on the internet.

st.text: Ke batla ho boloka inthaneteng.
st.label: Boloka inthaneteng

lines.description: Button: keep on this phone only (guest).
lines.source: Keep it on this phone only.

st.text: Boloka founung ena feela.
st.label: Founung ena feela

lines.description: Consent 1/5 (POPIA): before anything is stored on the server.
lines.source: Before we keep your information on the internet, listen to this.

zu.text: Ngaphambi kokuthi sigcine imininingwane yakho ku-inthanethi, lalela lokhu.

st.text: Pele re boloka dintlha tsa hao inthaneteng, mamela sena.

lines.source: We will keep: your picture, your secret code, locked so that nobody can read it, your language, and your progress: lessons, answers and skills. We do not need your name. We do not keep your voice.

zu.text: Sizogcina: isithombe sakho, ikhodi yakho eyimfihlo ivalelwe ukuze kungabikho muntu oyifundayo, ulimi lwakho, nenqubekela phambili yakho: izifundo, izimpendulo namakhono. Asilidingi igama lakho. Asiligcini izwi lakho.

st.text: Re tla boloka: setshwantsho sa hao, khoutu ya hao ya lekunutu e notleletswe hore ho se be motho ya e balang, puo ya hao, le tswelopele ya hao: dithuto, dikarabo le bokgoni. Ha re hloke lebitso la hao. Ha re boloke lentswe la hao.

lines.source: Why: so that your learning is not lost if your phone is lost or broken, and so that you can carry on using another phone.

zu.text: Kungani: ukuze ukufunda kwakho kungalahleki uma ifoni yakho ilahleka noma iphuka, nokuze uqhubeke kwenye ifoni.

st.text: Hobaneng: hore thuto ya hao e se ke ya lahleha ha founu ya hao e lahleha kapa e robeha, le hore o tswele pele founung e nngwe.

lines.source: Who can see it: only you. If you join a class later, we will first ask you what your teacher may see. We will never sell your information.

zu.text: Ubani ongakubona: nguwe kuphela. Uma ujoyina ikilasi kamuva, sizokubuza kuqala ukuthi uthisha wakho angabonani. Asisoze sayithengisa imininingwane yakho.

st.text: Ke mang ya ka e bonang: ke wena feela. Ha o kena tlelaseng hamorao, re tla o botsa pele hore titjhere ya hao a ka bona eng. Ha ho mohla re tla rekisa dintlha tsa hao.

lines.source: You can stop at any time. In Me, tap the picture of the bin to delete everything. It is deleted straight away, without phoning anyone.

zu.text: Ungayeka noma nini. Ku-Mina, thinta isithombe somgqomo ukuze ususe konke. Kuzosuswa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokushayela muntu.

st.text: O ka emisa neng kapa neng. Ho Nna, tobetsa setshwantsho sa motomo ho hlakola tsohle. Di tla hlakolwa hang-hang, ntle le ho letsetsa motho.

lines.source: Do you agree that we keep your learning safely on the internet?

zu.text: Uyavuma ukuthi sigcine ukufunda kwakho ku-inthanethi ngokuphepha?

st.text: Na o dumela hore re boloke thuto ya hao inthaneteng ka polokeho?

lines.source: Yes, I agree.

st.text: E, ke a dumela.
st.label: E, ke a dumela

lines.description: Consent button: keep on phone only.
lines.source: No, keep it on this phone only.

st.text: Tjhe, boloka founung feela.
st.label: Tjhe, founung feela

lines.description: Separate optional consent: pseudonymous usage counts.
lines.source: May we count how you use the app, without your name, so that we can improve it? You can change this at any time in Me.

zu.text: Singabala ukuthi uyisebenzisa kanjani i-app, ngaphandle kwegama lakho, ukuze siyithuthukise? Ungashintsha lokhu noma nini ku-Mina.

st.text: Na re ka bala hore o sebedisa app jwang, ntle le lebitso la hao, e le hore re e ntlafatse? O ka fetola sena neng kapa neng ho Nna.

lines.description: Confirm the PIN to save it safely online.
lines.source: Tap your secret code again, so that we can keep it safely.

zu.text: Thinta ikhodi yakho eyimfihlo futhi, ukuze siyigcine ngokuphepha.

st.text: Tobetsa khoutu ya hao ya lekunutu hape, hore re e boloke ka polokeho.

lines.source: That is fine. Your learning will stay on this phone only. You can change your mind later in Me.

zu.text: Kulungile. Ukufunda kwakho kuzohlala kule foni kuphela. Ungashintsha umqondo kamuva ku-Mina.

st.text: Ho lokile. Thuto ya hao e tla dula founung ena feela. O ka fetola mohopolo hamorao ho Nna.

lines.source: Thank you. Your learning is now kept safely.

st.text: Re a leboha. Thuto ya hao jwale e bolokilwe ka polokeho.

lines.source: Keeping it on the internet needs the internet. For now, your learning stays on this phone.

zu.text: Ukugcina ku-inthanethi kudinga i-inthanethi. Okwamanje, ukufunda kwakho kuhlala kule foni.

st.text: Ho boloka inthaneteng ho hloka inthanete. Hajwale, thuto ya hao e dula founung ena.

lines.source: If you withdraw your consent, we will delete your learning from the internet. It will stay on this phone only.

zu.text: Uma uhoxisa imvume, sizosusa ukufunda kwakho ku-inthanethi. Kuzohlala kule foni kuphela.
zu.label: Hoxisa imvume

st.text: Ha o hula tumello, re tla hlakola thuto ya hao inthaneteng. E tla dula founung ena feela.
st.label: Hula tumello

lines.source: Your teacher's class wants to see your progress. You choose what they may see.

zu.text: Ikilasi likathisha wakho lifuna ukubona inqubekela phambili yakho. Nguwe okhethayo ukuthi bangabonani.

st.text: Tlelase ya titjhere ya hao e batla ho bona tswelopele ya hao. Ke wena ya kgethang hore ba ka bona eng.

lines.description: Cohort sharing: what joining always shares.
lines.source: If you join, your teacher will see: your picture, your level, the lessons you have finished, and the last day you practised. They will also see numbers for the whole class about skills that were difficult, without pointing to you.

zu.text: Uma ujoyina, uthisha wakho uzobona: isithombe sakho, izinga lakho, izifundo oziqedile, nosuku lokugcina oprakthize ngalo. Uzobona nezibalo zekilasi lonke zamakhono abelukhuni, ngaphandle kokukhomba wena.

st.text: Ha o kena, titjhere ya hao o tla bona: setshwantsho sa hao, boemo ba hao, dithuto tseo o di qetileng, le letsatsi la ho qetela leo o ikwetlisitseng ka lona. O tla bona le dipalo tsa tlelase yohle tsa bokgoni bo neng bo le thata, ntle le ho o supa.

lines.description: Cohort sharing: optional mastery with dates (needed for certificates).
lines.source: Do you also want the teacher to see the skills you have learned, with the dates? This is needed for a certificate.

zu.text: Ingabe ufuna nokuthi uthisha abone amakhono owafundile, nezinsuku? Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze uthole isitifiketi.

st.text: Na o batla hape hore titjhere a bone bokgoni boo o ithutileng bona, le matsatsi? Sena se a hlokahala bakeng sa setifikeiti.

lines.source: Do you want the teacher to see the questions you got wrong, so that they can help you?

zu.text: Ingabe ufuna uthisha abone imibuzo oyiphosile, ukuze akusize?

st.text: Na o batla hore titjhere a bone dipotso tseo o di fositseng, e le hore a o thuse?

lines.description: Cohort sharing: optional tutor question log.
lines.source: Do you want the teacher to see the questions you asked the helper?

zu.text: Ingabe ufuna uthisha abone imibuzo oyibuze umsizi?

st.text: Na o batla hore titjhere a bone dipotso tseo o di botsitseng mothusi?

lines.source: Yes.

st.text: E.
st.label: E

lines.source: No.

st.text: Tjhe.
st.label: Tjhe

lines.source: Join the class.

st.text: Kena tlelaseng.
st.label: Kena tlelaseng

lines.description: Before stopping sharing with a class.
lines.source: If you stop sharing, your teacher stops seeing your progress straight away.

zu.text: Uma uyeka ukwabelana, uthisha wakho uzoyeka ngokushesha ukubona inqubekela phambili yakho.
zu.label: Yeka ukwabelana

st.text: Ha o emisa ho arolelana, titjhere ya hao o tla emisa hang-hang ho bona tswelopele ya hao.
st.label: Emisa ho arolelana

lines.source: Sharing has stopped.

st.text: Ho arolelana ho emisitswe.

zu.text: Joyina ikilasi lakho. Bhala inombolo ekhonjiswa uthisha wakho, noma uskene ikhodi eyisikwele.
zu.label: Joyina ikilasi

st.text: Kena tlelaseng ya hao. Ngola nomoro eo titjhere ya hao a o bontshang yona, kapa o skene khoutu e sekwere.
st.label: Kena tlelaseng

lines.description: Scan the class QR code with the camera.

st.text: Supa khoutu e sekwere ka khamera.
st.label: Skena khoutu

lines.description: Joining needs an online account first.
lines.source: To join a class, first keep your learning on the internet.

zu.text: Ukuze ujoyine ikilasi, qala ugcine ukufunda kwakho ku-inthanethi.

st.text: Ho kena tlelaseng, pele boloka thuto ya hao inthaneteng.

zu.text: Leyo nombolo ayisebenzanga. Yihlole nothisha wakho bese uzama futhi.

st.text: Nomoro eo ha e a sebetsa. E hlahlobe le titjhere ya hao, mme o leke hape.
Jwale o tlelaseng.

lines.source: Some activities ask you to say words aloud. To let you hear yourself, the app needs the microphone. Your voice stays on this phone and is deleted when the activity ends. You can say no and still use everything.

zu.text: Eminye imisebenzi ikucela ukuthi usho amagama ngezwi. Ukuze uzizwe, i-app idinga imakrofoni. Izwi lakho lihlala kule foni futhi liyasuswa uma umsebenzi uphela. Ungathi cha futhi usasebenzisa konke.

st.text: Mesebetsi e meng e o kopa ho bua mantswe ka lentswe. Ho iutlwa, app e hloka maekrofounu. Lentswe la hao le dula founung ena mme le hlakolwa ha mosebetsi o fela. O ka re tjhe mme wa nna wa sebedisa tsohle.

lines.source: Allow the microphone.

st.text: Dumella maekrofounu.
st.label: Dumella maekrofounu

lines.source: No, thank you.

st.text: Tjhe, ke a leboha.
st.label: Tjhe, ke a leboha

lines.source: No problem. Say the words aloud without recording, then tap the arrow when you have finished.

zu.text: Akunankinga. Sho amagama ngezwi ngaphandle kokuqopha, bese uthinta umcibisholo uma usuqedile.

st.text: Ha ho bothata. Bua mantswe ka lentswe ntle le ho rekota, ebe o tobetsa motsu ha o qetile.

lines.description: Tap the microphone to record yourself.

st.text: Tobetsa maekrofounu mme o bue lentswe.
st.label: Rekota

zu.text: Lalela isibonelo, bese uzilalela wena. Ingabe kuzwakale kufana?

st.text: Mamela mohlala, ebe o iteetsa. Na ho utlwahetse ho tshwana?

zu.text: Sho igama ngezwi manje. Bese uthinta umcibisholo oluhlaza.

st.text: Bua lentswe ka lentswe jwale. Ebe o tobetsa motsu o motala.
Ho a tshwana.
st.label: Ho a tshwana

st.text: Ho fapane.
st.label: Ho fapane

lines.description: After a self-check (always recorded as practised, never scored).

zu.text: Kuhle ukuprakthiza! Ukusho amagama ngezwi kuyakusiza ukuthi uwakhumbule.

st.text: Ho hotle ho ikwetlisa! Ho bua mantswe ka lentswe ho o thusa ho a hopola.

zu.text: Zikhethele isithombe. Sizokusiza ukuthola ukufunda kwakho kule foni.

st.text: Ikgethele setshwantsho. Se tla o thusa ho fumana thuto ya hao founung ena.

zu.text: Manje yenza ikhodi yakho eyimfihlo: thinta izithombe ezine. Zikhumbule, futhi ungazikhombisi muntu.

st.text: Jwale etsa khoutu ya hao ya lekunutu: tobetsa ditshwantsho tse nne. Di hopole, mme o se ke wa di bontsha motho.
Tobetsa ditshwantsho tse nne tse tshwanang hape.
Dikhoutu tse pedi ha di tshwane. A re e etseng hape.
Tobetsa ditshwantsho tsa hao tse nne tsa lekunutu.
Khoutu eo ha e a nepahala. Leka hape.

lines.description: Too many wrong PINs: short wait.

zu.text: Sicela ulinde kancane, bese uzama futhi. Uma ukhohlwe ikhodi yakho, cela uthisha wakho akusize.

st.text: Ka kopo ema hanyane, ebe o leka hape. Ha o lebetse khoutu ya hao, kopa titjhere ya hao hore a o thuse.
Khoutu ya hao ya lekunutu e bolokilwe.

lines.description: Profile picker on a shared phone.

zu.text: Ngubani ofundayo manje? Thinta isithombe sakho.

st.text: Ke mang ya ithutang jwale? Tobetsa setshwantsho sa hao.

lines.description: Add another learner on this phone.

st.text: Eketsa moithuti e mong founung ena.
st.label: Moithuti e motjha

st.text: Fetola moithuti.
st.label: Fetola moithuti

zu.text: Ungathanda ukwenza umsebenzi omfushane ukuze sithole indawo engcono yokuqala? Uthatha cishe imizuzu emihlanu. Akusona isivivinyo, futhi awudingi ukukhathazeka ngamaphutha.

st.text: Na o ka rata ho etsa mosebetsi o mokgutshwane hore re fumane sebaka se setle sa ho qala? O nka metsotso e ka bang mehlano. Hase tlhahlobo, mme ha o a tlameha ho tshwenyeha ka diphoso.
Qala.
st.label: Qala

st.text: Tlola.
st.label: Tlola

lines.description: Neutral acknowledgement after every placement answer (never right/wrong).

st.text: Ke a leboha.

zu.text: Siyabonga. Sithole indawo enhle yokuthi uqale khona.

st.text: Re a leboha. Re fumane sebaka se setle sa hore o qale teng.

lines.description: Self-placement when the activity is skipped.

st.text: Na o kgona ho bala mantswe a Sesotho?

lines.description: Self-placement: can read the home language.

st.text: E, ke a kgona.
st.label: E, ke a kgona

lines.description: Self-placement: cannot read yet / not sure.

st.text: Ha ke eso kgone, kapa ha ke na bonnete.
st.label: Ha ke eso kgone

zu.text: Asiqale ngokufunda ngesiZulu. Kwenza isiNgisi sibe lula.

st.text: A re qaleng ka ho bala ka Sesotho. Ho etsa hore Senyesemane se be bonolo.
A re qaleng ka ditlhaku le medumo ya Senyesemane.
A re qaleng ka mantswe a hao a pele a Senyesemane.
A re qaleng ka dipolelo.

zu.text: Asiqale ngesiNgisi sansuku zonke: ama-SMS nezimpawu.

st.text: A re qaleng ka Senyesemane sa letsatsi le letsatsi: di-SMS le matshwao.

zu.text: Ungashintsha lapho uqala khona noma nini.

st.text: O ka fetola moo o qalang teng neng kapa neng.

zu.text: Siyakwamukela futhi! Thinta inkinobho enkulu ukuze uqhubeke ufunda.

st.text: Rea o amohela hape! Tobetsa konopo e kgolo ho tswela pele ho ithuta.
Tswela pele ho ithuta.
st.label: Tswela pele

st.text: Ikwetlise mantswe a neng a le thata ho wena.
st.label: Ikwetlise

st.text: O ikwetlisitse kajeno. O entse hantle!

zu.text: Uqede zonke izifundo ezikhona manje. Qhubeka uprakthize!

st.text: O qetile dithuto tsohle tse teng hajwale. Tswela pele ho ikwetlisa!
Dithuto.
st.label: Ithute

st.text: Boikwetliso.
st.label: Ikwetlise

st.text: Tswelopele ya hao.
st.label: Tswelopele

st.text: Nna: disetting le dintlha tsa ka.
st.label: Nna

zu.text: Nazi izifundo zakho. Thinta indilinga ukuze uqale.

st.text: Dithuto tsa hao ke tsena. Tobetsa sedikadikwe ho qala.

lines.description: Tapping a lesson that is not open yet.

zu.text: Lesi sifundo sizovuleka uma uqeda esingaphambi kwaso.

st.text: Thuto ena e tla buleha ha o qeta e e etellang pele.

zu.text: Ufuna ukumisa isifundo? Inqubekela phambili yakho igciniwe.

st.text: Na o batla ho emisa thuto? Tswelopele ya hao e bolokilwe.
Emisa.
st.label: Emisa

st.text: Tswela pele.
st.label: Tswela pele

st.text: Thuto e fedile! O entse hantle.
Thuto e latelang.
st.label: E latelang

st.text: A re ikwetliseng dintho tse neng di le thata ho wena.
Ha ho letho la ho ikwetlisa hona jwale. O entse hantle!
Boikwetliso bo fedile.
Sena ke seo o se ithutileng.
O fumane beche e ntjha!

zu.text: Lapha ungashintsha izilungiselelo zakho futhi unakekele imininingwane yakho.

st.text: Mona o ka fetola disetting tsa hao mme o hlokomele dintlha tsa hao.
Fetola puo eo o ithutang ka yona.
st.label: Puo

st.text: Etsa mongolo o be moholo.
st.label: Boholo ba mongolo

st.text: Bontsha mantswe ka tlasa lentswe.
st.label: Mantswe ka tlase

zu.text: Landa izifundo kuphela uma uku-Wi-Fi, ukuze ungasebenzisi idatha.
zu.label: Wi-Fi kuphela

st.text: Jarolla dithuto feela ha o le ho Wi-Fi, hore o se sebedise data.
st.label: Wi-Fi feela

st.text: Kgetha moo o batlang ho qala teng.
st.label: Fetola boemo

zu.text: Phinda umsebenzi omfushane ukuze sithole izinga elifanele.
zu.label: Phinda umsebenzi

st.text: Etsa mosebetsi o mokgutshwane hape hore re fumane boemo bo nepahetseng.
st.label: Etsa hape

lines.description: Download a copy of my data.
lines.source: You can get a copy of all the information about you that we keep.

zu.text: Ungathola ikhophi yayo yonke imininingwane yakho esiyigcinile.
zu.label: Ikhophi yemininingwane

st.text: O ka fumana kopi ya dintlha tsohle tsa hao tseo re di bolokileng.
st.label: Kopi ya dintlha

lines.source: Delete all my information.

st.text: Hlakola dintlha tsohle tsa ka.
st.label: Hlakola tsohle

lines.description: What I share with my class.

zu.text: Bheka noma ushintshe okwabelana nekilasi lakho.
zu.label: Okwabelana

st.text: Sheba kapa o fetole seo o se arolelanang le tlelase ya hao.
st.label: Ho arolelana

zu.text: Landa izifundo ukuze uzisebenzise ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
zu.label: Ukulanda

st.text: Jarolla dithuto ho di sebedisa ntle le inthanete.
st.label: Ho jarolla

lines.description: Facilitator help (teacher signs in on this phone).

zu.text: Uthisha angakusiza kule foni. Ikhodi yakho eyimfihlo ihlala iyimfihlo.
zu.label: Usizo lukathisha

st.text: Titjhere a ka o thusa founung ena. Khoutu ya hao ya lekunutu e dula e le lekunutu.
st.label: Thuso ya titjhere

lines.description: This phone's online session was replaced: the learner was moved to another phone. Offers removing the profile from this phone.

zu.text: Izifundo zakho ezigcinwe ku-inthanethi manje zikwenye ifoni. Okwenzayo lapha kuhlala kule foni kuphela. Ungasusa le phrofayela kule foni.
zu.label: Susa kule foni

st.text: Dithuto tsa hao tse bolokilweng inthaneteng di se di le founung e nngwe. Seo o se etsang mona se dula founung ena feela. O ka tlosa profaele ena founung ena.
st.label: Tlosa founung ena

lines.source: If you delete, everything about you is removed from this phone and from our system. Your teacher will no longer see you. This cannot be undone. To delete, press and hold the red button.

zu.text: Uma usula, konke okumayelana nawe kuzosuswa kule foni nasohlelweni lwethu. Uthisha wakho ngeke esakubona. Lokhu akunakuhlehliswa. Ukuze usule, cindezela ubambe inkinobho ebomvu.

st.text: Ha o hlakola, tsohle tse mabapi le wena di tla tloswa founung ena le tsamaisong ya rona. Titjhere ya hao a ke ke a hlola a o bona. Sena se ke ke sa kgutliswa. Ho hlakola, tobetsa o tshware konopo e kgubedu.

lines.source: Hold to delete.

st.text: Tshwara ho hlakola.
st.label: Tshwara ho hlakola

lines.source: Everything has been deleted. Thank you for learning with us.

st.text: Tsohle di hlakotswe. Re a leboha ka ho ithuta le rona.

lines.source: Deleting from the internet needs the internet. Try again when you are connected.

zu.text: Ukususa ku-inthanethi kudinga i-inthanethi. Zama futhi uma usuxhunyiwe.

st.text: Ho hlakola inthaneteng ho hloka inthanete. Leka hape ha o hokahane.

lines.source: Your copy is ready.

st.text: Kopi ya hao e se e lokile.

zu.text: Landa izifundo ukuze uzisebenzise ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Usayizi ukhonjiswa ngaphambi kokulanda.
